metadata.mapping_view_definition:
SELECT canonical.nhl_player_id::text AS nhl_player_id,
    canonical.canonical_name AS nhl_player_name,
    COALESCE(player.editorial_team_abbreviation, legacy.nhl_team_abbreviation::character varying)::text AS nhl_team_abbreviation,
    player.player_key AS yahoo_player_id,
    COALESCE(player.full_name, player.player_name, legacy.yahoo_player_name) AS yahoo_player_name,
    COALESCE(player.editorial_team_abbreviation, legacy.yahoo_team) AS yahoo_team,
    COALESCE(player.percent_ownership, legacy.percent_ownership) AS percent_ownership,
    COALESCE(player.eligible_positions, legacy.eligible_positions) AS eligible_positions,
    COALESCE(player.injury_note, legacy.injury_note) AS injury_note,
    COALESCE(player.status, legacy.status) AS status,
    COALESCE(player.status_full, legacy.status_full) AS status_full,
    legacy.points,
    legacy.goals,
    legacy.assists,
    legacy.shots,
    legacy.pp_points,
    legacy.blocked_shots,
    legacy.hits,
    legacy.total_fow,
    legacy.penalty_minutes,
    legacy.sh_points,
    legacy.wins,
    legacy.losses,
    legacy.saves,
    legacy.shots_against,
    legacy.shutouts,
    legacy.quality_start,
    legacy.goals_against_avg,
    legacy.save_pct,
    COALESCE(player.position_type, legacy.player_type::character varying)::text AS player_type,
        CASE
            WHEN lower(COALESCE(player.position_type, legacy.player_type::character varying, ''::character varying)::text) = ANY (ARRAY['g'::text, 'goalie'::text]) THEN 'G'::text
            ELSE 'Skater'::text
        END AS player_position,
        CASE
            WHEN lower(COALESCE(player.position_type, legacy.player_type::character varying, ''::character varying)::text) = ANY (ARRAY['g'::text, 'goalie'::text]) THEN 'G'::text
            ELSE 'Skater'::text
        END AS mapped_position,
        CASE
            WHEN lower(COALESCE(player.position_type, legacy.player_type::character varying, ''::character varying)::text) = ANY (ARRAY['g'::text, 'goalie'::text]) THEN 'G'::text
            ELSE 'Skater'::text
        END AS normalized_position,
    immutable_unaccent(lower(COALESCE(player.editorial_team_abbreviation, legacy.nhl_team_abbreviation::character varying, legacy.yahoo_team)::text)) AS normalized_team,
    NULL::numeric AS percent_games,
    canonical.fhfh_player_id
   FROM verified_yahoo_player_identities_read() canonical(external_player_id, season_id, fhfh_player_id, nhl_player_id, canonical_name)
     JOIN yahoo_players player ON player.player_key::text = canonical.external_player_id
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT mapping.nhl_player_id,
            mapping.nhl_player_name,
            mapping.nhl_team_abbreviation,
            mapping.name_norm,
            mapping.player_type,
            mapping.points,
            mapping.goals,
            mapping.assists,
            mapping.shots,
            mapping.pp_points,
            mapping.blocked_shots,
            mapping.hits,
            mapping.total_fow,
            mapping.penalty_minutes,
            mapping.sh_points,
            mapping.wins,
            mapping.losses,
            mapping.saves,
            mapping.shots_against,
            mapping.shutouts,
            mapping.quality_start,
            mapping.goals_against_avg,
            mapping.save_pct,
            mapping.yahoo_player_id,
            mapping.yahoo_player_name,
            mapping.yahoo_team,
            mapping.percent_ownership,
            mapping.eligible_positions,
            mapping.injury_note,
            mapping.status,
            mapping.status_full,
            mapping.mapped_position
           FROM yahoo_nhl_player_map mapping
          WHERE mapping.nhl_player_id = canonical.nhl_player_id::text AND (mapping.yahoo_player_id::text = ANY (ARRAY[player.player_key, player.player_id]::text[]))
          ORDER BY (mapping.yahoo_player_id::text = player.player_key::text) DESC, mapping.percent_ownership DESC NULLS LAST
         LIMIT 1) legacy ON true;
